findings.detail: Current validation requires exactly the expected number of items and at least one non-preview/non-mockup typed file per item, but it does not compare returned printable file count/types with the files planned in each corresponding plan.items entry. A partial files list containing one valid file can therefore be treated as complete even if additional planned print placements are absent.

A file entry with a valid type but missing/blank status is classified by the legacy evaluator as datei-abgelehnt, not datei-unvollstaendig. It is blocked from automatic confirmation, but not given the requested incomplete-answer review category.
